# Check if the port is in the "listen" state.
# The first parameter is the PID of the process that should

# transfer.

check_port()
{
    local pid="${1:-0}"
    local port="$2"
    local utils="$3"

    [ $pid -le 0 ] && pid='[0-9]+'

            grep -q -E "[[:space:]]users:[[:space:]]?\\(.*\\(\"($utils)[^[:space:]]*\"[^)]*,pid=$pid(,[^)]*)?\\)" && rc=0
    elif [ $sockstat_available -ne 0 ]; then

        exit 2 # ENOENT
    fi

    return $rc
}
